g.text: Model FLOPs utilization: DDP against DiLoCo, by fabric

text.style: opacity: 1; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: rgb(34, 34, 34); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
opacity: 1; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: rgb(34, 34, 34); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: rgb(85, 85, 85); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Dashed: one A100 on its own, 60.1%. DiLoCo holds that level on every
fabric, because it all-reduces once per 500 steps. That is a claim about the
GPUs, not about the result: at equal tokens DiLoCo ends 0.245 worse, and it
needs about 2.5× the tokens to catch up.
